implemented_capabilities.notes: All agent state (Agent, Goal, Task, Observation, Belief, Constraint nodes) lives in one FalkorDB graph via parameterized Cypher; agents never call each other. get_pending_tasks uses OPTIONAL MATCH on DEPENDS_ON with count(d)=0 to find dependency-ready tasks.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Atomic task claiming (compare-and-set lock) with stale-lock release
implemented_capabilities.notes: lock_task does MATCH ... WHERE t.status=$from SET t.status=$to in one Cypher query and returns false if nothing matched; the ASSIGNED_TO edge is written in a second, non-atomic query. release_stale_locks reverts locked/verifying tasks after a 60s timeout.

Tasks go pending -> verifying -> verified|blocked; blocked adds a VIOLATES edge to the Constraint and an Observation. 'forbidden_keyword' constraints are a crude stemmed substring match; 'policy' constraints are a YES/NO LLM prompt that fails closed. Blocked status propagates to dependents via a Cypher SET on (t)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(b {status:'blocked'}) run every cycle.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Belief / observation memory with support and contradiction links
implemented_capabilities.notes: Observation -[:SUPPORTS|CONTRADICTS]-> Belief edges with heuristic confidence deltas (+0.1 / -0.25). The decision of which observations support or contradict is an LLM JSON prompt (LLM_PROMPT_ONLY for the semantic part); the graph bookkeeping is real. No supersession or validity windows.

implemented_capabilities.capability: LLM planner decomposing goals into dependency DAG of tasks
implemented_capabilities.notes: Task decomposition is an LLM JSON prompt with a hard-coded 3-task fallback; the real part is writing tasks in status 'planning' then releasing to 'pending' only after all DEPENDS_ON edges exist.
mock_action sleeps and returns a random canned string ('API call returned 200 OK' etc.); nothing is actually executed.
Groq -> Gemini -> optional local Ollama fallback chain with exponential backoff on 429/timeout/503.
Streamlit + pyvis render of the blackboard with colour per label and dark-red blocked tasks; starts agents in a daemon thread.

graph_models_and_cypher: Labels: Agent, Goal, Task(status: planning|pending|verifying|verified|locked|blocked|done), Observation(embedding list prop), Belief(confidence), Constraint(rule,type). Edges: HAS_TASK, DEPENDS_ON, ASSIGNED_TO, PRODUCED, YIELDED, VIOLATES, SUPPORTS, CONTRADICTS. Patterns: OPTIONAL MATCH + count(d)=0 for dependency readiness; WITH ... ORDER BY LIMIT 1 for latest goal; CAS via WHERE status=$from SET. Plain openCypher plus 'CREATE INDEX FOR (n:Label) ON (n.prop)'; no APOC/GDS, no vector index (embeddings are stored as raw float list but never queried).
algorithms: Dependency-ready task selection via OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(d) WHERE d.status<>'done' WITH count(d) in graph_client.py:get_pending_tasks
Compare-and-set task lock with timeout-based lease release in graph_client.py:lock_task/release_stale_locks
Blocked-status propagation to dependents (iterative one-hop Cypher each cycle) in agents.py:SafetyVerifierAgent.step
Heuristic belief confidence update (+0.1 support, -0.25 contradiction, clamped 0..1) in agents.py:MemoryCuratorAgent.step and graph_client.py:update_belief_confidence
backend_interfaces: No HTTP API. main.py asyncio orchestrator (python main.py '<goal>'); Streamlit app.py acts as UI and in-process agent host. Python module API GraphClient.
frontend_interfaces: Streamlit single page (app.py) with pyvis force-directed graph, goal submit box, constraint add box, agent status list, belief progress bars
agent_or_memory_mechanisms: Blackboard architecture: Planner, SafetyVerifier, 2x Executor, MemoryCurator agents poll the FalkorDB graph on intervals and coordinate only through node status transitions (planning->pending->verifying->verified->locked->done|blocked). Memory = Observation and Belief nodes with SUPPORTS/CONTRADICTS edges and numeric confidence.
tests_present: No test suite. test_populate.py is a single smoke script (needs a live FalkorDB on localhost:6379) that seeds data, asserts get_pending_tasks and lock_task exclusivity, and writes graph_preview.html.
security_findings: llm_router.py:38-39 - API keys read from environment (GROQ_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY); no hard-coded secrets found; .gitignore excludes .env
llm_router.py:73 - unauthenticated HTTP call to local Ollama endpoint http://localhost:11434 (only when OLLAMA_ENABLED=true)
graph_client.py:227 - f-string interpolates relationship type into Cypher, but value is restricted to the constants SUPPORTS/CONTRADICTS (not injectable)
agents.py:167-170 - task description and constraint rule are interpolated into an LLM prompt for policy checks (prompt-injection could flip YES/NO verdict; verifier fails closed only on exceptions)
app.py:73 - UI button runs unconditional DETACH DELETE of all Task/Goal/Observation/Belief nodes with no auth
graph_client.py:66-72 - clear() deletes the whole graph; no guard
duplicates_or_overlaps: Overlaps generic agent-memory / multi-agent blackboard patterns and approval-gating workflows; not a domain analytics engine.
evidence_drift_relevance: MEDIUM - has an approval gate (pending->verified|blocked with VIOLATES edges), dependency-driven blocking propagation and SUPPORTS/CONTRADICTS confidence decay on beliefs, but no temporal validity, supersession or lineage versioning.

strongest_reusable_unit.why: Small, FalkorDB-native parameterized-Cypher primitives for atomic task claiming, dependency-ready scheduling and belief support/contradiction bookkeeping that map directly onto an evidence/approval ledger.
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: FalkorDB (falkordb client); LLM key only for curator/planner/policy agents; sentence-transformers optional

strategy_rationale: The executor is a mock and planner/curator are LLM prompts, so the value is the graph schema and CAS/lease pattern, which is small enough to re-implement cleanly in Kairos. No license file, so copy only after owner permission is confirmed.
